name: AR_CMGT_CF_TEMPLATE
description: This table contains the credit case folder templates, used during new case folder creation.

columns.description: Case folder template unique identifier.

columns.name: DEFAULT_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the case folder template is the default template.

columns.name: REVIEW_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Review type for the case folder template. Values are based on the lookup AR_CMGT_REVIEW_TYPE.
